fieldHelp.pcHost:
1. Open Settings on the PC.
2. Open the properties of the current connection under Network & internet.
3. Find the IPv4 address and enter it here.

Example: 192.168.0.10
fieldHelp.pcUsername:
1. Open PowerShell on the PC.
2. Run whoami.
3. Enter the name shown after the backslash (\).

Example: enter admin for PC-NAME\admin
fieldHelp.pcPort:
1. Open an administrator PowerShell on the PC.
2. Run Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\OpenSSH.
3. Use the default value 22 if you did not configure another port.
fieldHelp.pcMac:
1. Open Settings on the PC.
2. Open the network adapter’s hardware properties.
3. Find and enter the physical address (MAC).

Example: 2C:F0:5D:83:5B:07
fieldHelp.routerHost:
1. Find the current network’s default gateway on the PC.
2. Enter the displayed IPv4 address.

Example: 192.168.0.1
fieldHelp.routerUsername:
1. Open the network equipment (router) admin page.
2. Find the username used for SSH access.
3. Use the SSH setting because it may differ from the admin-page login.
fieldHelp.routerPort:
1. Open the SSH settings on the network equipment (router).
2. Find the port used by the SSH service.
3. Use the default value 22 if it was not changed.
fieldHelp.wolInterface:
1. Connect to the network equipment (router) over SSH.
2. Run ip link.
3. Enter the LAN interface connected to the PC.

Example: br0 or lan0
